scope: Every CSV member in all 21 pinned Reports-Archives-Multiple ZIPs; two separately counted root June 8 CSV comparisons

method.source_rows_retained: all five aggregate rows per member retained as original strings, ordered by original header; no private investor records
method.preamble_policy: Preserved verbatim outside CSV table; strict parser diagnoses malformed double-quoted preamble; row 2 is real header
method.header_policy: Original header retained; strip whitespace only for canonical comparison
method.numeric_policy: All 14 numeric fields checked against nonnegative decimal integer syntax; Python arbitrary precision integer arithmetic; no rounding, null-to-zero conversion or repair
method.date_policy: Independent DDMMYYYY archive/member name dates compared with explicit English-month preamble date
formulas_recomputed: Sum four participant categories compared with reported TOTAL for each of 14 fields
Sum six product components for each category and TOTAL compared with stated long and short totals
Reported TOTAL long minus short and sum of participant long-minus-short checked independently for six products and aggregate total
method.source_validation_limit: Local pinned release integrity and internal arithmetic only. No fresh NSE download, official session calendar, authenticity attestation or current-market validation.

reproducibility_helper.usage: bundled python ash-participant-snapshot-audit.py emits JSON to stdout; --summary emits summary only; no file writes or supplied-code execution

shared_schema.grain: report-kind / observed-date / participant category; six derivatives product classes aggregated market-wide
shared_schema.units: number of contracts, explicitly stated in each preamble

date_coverage.warning: Weekday gaps are diagnostic only, not assertions of missing NSE trading sessions; neither holidays nor special sessions were queried. Snapshot order cannot stand in for consecutive daily observations.

findings.finding: One-contract OI arithmetic residuals remain unresolved
findings.evidence: 45 of 210 participant/TOTAL row-side component sums differ from stated totals; 35 of 294 fieldwise sums of four categories differ from reported TOTAL. Every nonzero residual is +1 or -1 contract. All 147 published TOTAL long-short comparisons agree, while 29 sums of category net pairs do not equal zero.
findings.decision: Retain original OI counts and exact residuals. No authorized reconciliation tolerance, official-source explanation, rounding rule or data repair has been established.

findings.finding: Volume arithmetic reconciles for every supplied snapshot
findings.evidence: All 210 row-side component sums, 294 category-to-TOTAL sums and 147 TOTAL long-short pairs match exactly for 21 volume members.
findings.decision: Useful historical parser/reconciliation fixtures. Arithmetic agreement does not validate source authenticity, currentness or use as stock ownership/cash flow.

findings.finding: Preamble is not a rectangular CSV record
findings.evidence: All 42 title lines fail strict CSV parsing because of doubled enclosing quotes. Each body is a strict-valid 15-column header plus five complete rows.
findings.decision: Treat line1 as preserved report metadata and start the table at line2. Do not count title/header/TOTAL as extra participants.

findings.finding: Sparse snapshots cannot supply rolling daily positioning features
findings.evidence: Twenty-one dates span 203 calendar days; largest adjacent gap is 32 days. Root June8 adds only one date. Earlier audited PWOI history ends in April2023.
findings.decision: NO09 remains SOURCE_REQUIRED for verified daily inputs and a precise 60D change/z-score contract; do not relabel consecutive supplied snapshots as consecutive NSE sessions.

prior_PWOI_evidence_comparison.read_scope: Prior published JSON findings and schema reread; original historical PWOI CSV not re-audited in this batch

prior_integrity_findings_not_repaired.interpretation: Wide view deduplicates dates and preserves missing numerical cells, but rounds fractional source contract counts in some rows. Neither fractional source counts nor rounding policy is independently justified. Missing-to-zero behavior appears in subsequent feature/long-table derivation.

prior_missing_operand_findings_not_repai.interpretation: Some supplied feature/long-table outputs behave as missing operands replaced by zero. Do not use such outputs as verified observed positioning.

prior_PWOI_evidence_comparison.conclusion: Same participant/product/side OI schema can support explicit historical staging, but snapshots do not repair 2023-2025 continuity or earlier derived missing-to-zero and rounding problems. Volume is a separate daily flow, not a duplicate OI stock.

consumer_mapping.potential_use: Dated market-wide index-futures net positioning inputs
consumer_mapping.missing: Verified consecutive session history and an approved definition of change/z-score lookback, publication availability timing, revisions and lot-size comparability. Twenty-one sparse dates are not a 60D z-score window.

consumer_mapping.reason: No stock/ISIN identity, equity-holding percentage or quarterly ownership change in participant derivative counts.
Contracts are neither rupees/crore cash purchases/sales nor five verified consecutive cash sessions.
Market-aggregate categories have no instrument/expiry/strike/price linkage; summing puts and calls here does not establish stock-specific PCR/long buildup.

consumer_mapping.consumer: Historical parser and aggregate-position reconciliation fixtures
consumer_mapping.reason: Exact bytes, full rows, dates and units preserved; total discrepancies remain explicit and no zeros are imputed.

limitations_and_source_required: Published totals and category/component sums may disagree; retain original values and residuals, do not silently repair or infer rounding cause.
TOTAL is an aggregate control, never a fifth participant to add to Client/DII/FII/Pro.
Open interest is a point-in-time stock of contracts; trading volume is a dated flow. Do not sum snapshots as current holdings or conflate volume with OI.
Options count long-minus-short is not signed delta exposure; long puts and short calls cannot be collapsed into directional conviction without further contracts.
No underlying ticker, ISIN, expiry, strike, price, lot size, publication timestamp or revision version is supplied.
NSE provenance is a report-format/source claim within preserved GitHub assets, not a fresh official endpoint verification.
No source files, runtime, portfolio, universe, Mongo collection, score/rank or hard gate were changed.
